lines.text: The man says he has seen affliction under the rod of God's wrath and walks in darkness.
He says God walled him in, weighed him down with chains, and shut out his prayer.
He pictures God as a leopard lying in wait, then says God pierced his kidneys with arrows.
His people mock him in song, and God ground his teeth with ashes.
He says his strength and his hope from the LORD have perished, and his soul is humbled.
